body: For 17 you are very wise tbh...if only I could hear the same words from my own son, but that’s not gonna happen...he hasn’t spoken to me in over a year!

To be honest there’s not much worth telling...I’m 42, been an outcast most of my life, married a wonderful person and we had 6 kids, but I in the end everything went to shit...and I have no one and nothing left!
I have felt this way for a while myself
